what_this_is: Every shipped model, the physical quantity it predicts, and what measured or reference evidence for that quantity could be obtained in this environment. Filled in from the evidence search recorded in EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE.json, before any comparison was run.
the_question_each_row_answers: Is there credible measured or reference-measurement evidence for the quantity THIS MODEL PREDICTS, inside the regime this model claims?
what_this_surface_refuses_to_do: Count an independent mathematical oracle as empirical evidence. Rounds 5 and 6 established mathematical and independent-problem agreement for all 16 models; none of that appears in the empirical column here.
Count ngspice as empirical evidence. It is an external numerical solver, LEVEL 4/5, and the previous round already recorded it as such.
Count evidence for a model INPUT as evidence for the model. CODATA fixes the molar gas constant the CSTR model is handed; it says nothing about whether the reactor balances are right.

models.predicts: body temperature T(t), steady-state temperature, thermal time constant
models.declared_capability: one body at one uniform temperature, constant C and hA, one exchange path to one prescribed ambient, constant imposed heat
models.applicability_range: wherever the lumped assumption holds; the record does not fix a Biot bound, the caller declares the body
possible_empirical_sources: a measured cooling or heating transient of a body whose C and hA are independently known
a guarded-hot-plate or calorimetric transient with documented setup
models.calibration_required: YES - hA is almost never independently known for a real body and would have to be fitted from the same transient
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT. The search recorded in EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE.json found no measured transient-temperature dataset with a documented body, documented C and hA, and stated uncertainty that is reachable from this environment. Teaching-repository cooling curves were found and rejected for provenance.

models.predicts: normalised midpoint temperature of a slab with Dirichlet ends and a single-mode initial profile
models.declared_capability: linear diffusion, constant alpha, one space dimension, a prescribed initial profile that is exactly the first Fourier mode
models.applicability_range: the declared initial condition only; the quantity of interest is a nodal value at x = L/2
possible_empirical_sources: a measured transient conduction experiment whose initial temperature profile is a half-sine and whose faces are held at a fixed temperature
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT, and the initial condition is the harder obstacle: no physical experiment establishes a half-sine initial profile. The quantity this model predicts is not one an experiment produces. A measured conduction experiment would validate a DIFFERENT problem, which is why none is forced in here.

models.predicts: open-circuit voltage against state of charge, terminal voltage under load, Joule heat
models.declared_capability: one constant series resistance for the whole overpotential; OCV an affine chord between two declared endpoints UNLESS the cell declares a curve, in which case the curve governs over its declared interval
models.applicability_range: discharge only, one uniform temperature, no hysteresis, no diffusion or double-layer dynamics
possible_empirical_sources: measured relaxed open-circuit voltage against state of charge
models.calibration_required: PARTIAL - the two chord endpoints, or the curve samples, are declarations a caller supplies; they are taken from measurement here and are labelled CALIBRATION

models.predicts: state of charge against time, z(t) = z0 - I t / (eta Q)
models.declared_capability: constant current over the interval, no rate derating, no self-discharge beyond the declared efficiency, no feedback
models.applicability_range: constant-current discharge at one uniform temperature
possible_empirical_sources: a constant-current discharge with the current recorded
models.reason_if_no: EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT. The one measured constant-current discharge dataset reachable here (S-DCHG) records voltage against time and does NOT record the discharge current. Its three profiles are labelled 'C1/1, C2/2, C3/3', whose natural reading is 1C, C/2 and C/3; the measured durations are about 1.0 h, 4.0 h and 8.8 h, which contradicts that reading by more than a factor of two. The current is a required input of this model and cannot be recovered from the published metadata without inventing it. See DATASET_INTERPRETATION in VALIDATION_RESULTS.json.

models.predicts: time to the first cutoff, t = (z0 - z_stop) eta Q / I
models.declared_capability: constant current for the whole run; stops at the first cutoff and claims nothing beyond it
required_parameters: a cutoff voltage or cutoff state of charge
the Rint/OCV parameters that turn a voltage cutoff into a state of charge
models.applicability_range: constant-current discharge to a declared cutoff
possible_empirical_sources: measured time from a declared start state to a declared cutoff voltage at a known constant current
models.reason_if_no: EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT, for the same reason as coulomb counting: the discharge current in S-DCHG is not documented. The measured cutoff TIMES are in the dataset and are usable the moment a current appears with them.

models.predicts: effective deliverable capacity against discharge current, Q_eff = Q_nom (I_ref/I)^(k-1)
models.declared_capability: an empirical correlation whose exponent is a fit, established for lead-acid and contested for lithium-ion in the source the record itself cites
models.applicability_range: constant current, within the declared current and temperature range the exponent was fitted over
possible_empirical_sources: measured delivered capacity at three or more constant currents, with the currents recorded
models.calibration_required: YES - the exponent is a fit by the model's own declaration, so a calibration/validation split over rates is mandatory
models.reason_if_no: EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT. S-DCHG has exactly the shape this model needs - three constant-current rates on ten cells - and is unusable for it because the currents are not recorded. Deriving the currents from the durations and the nominal capacity would be assuming the answer: the delivered capacity at each rate is precisely what Peukert's law predicts and is therefore not available as an input.

models.predicts: node voltages of a resistive network
possible_empirical_sources: measured node voltages of a physically built network with calibrated instruments and traceable component values
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT, and deliberately not manufactured. There is no laboratory here. Kirchhoff's current law is a conservation statement rather than a constitutive correlation, and the previous round already established agreement with an independently written simulator to 6e-13. Reading ngspice output and relabelling it a measurement is the specific move this round forbids.

models.predicts: branch current and dissipated power of a resistor
models.declared_capability: V = I R with a temperature-independent resistance
possible_empirical_sources: a measured I-V sweep of a traceable standard resistor
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT. No traceable I-V measurement is reachable here.

models.predicts: the terminal voltage difference a source holds, irrespective of current
possible_empirical_sources: measured load regulation of a real supply
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT. A measured supply would in any case falsify the IDEAL model by construction, which is what the companion regulated-source record exists to bound.

models.predicts: the current a source holds, irrespective of terminal voltage
possible_empirical_sources: measured compliance of a real current source

models.predicts: the fraction of a declared regulation band the source's internal drop consumes
models.declared_capability: the ideal source relation asserted only inside a declared regulation band
models.applicability_range: where the internal drop stays inside the declared band
possible_empirical_sources: a supply datasheet's measured load-regulation figure together with its output impedance
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT, and the band is a caller's declaration of what a design tolerates rather than a property of the world. The record itself says so. There is no external number for it to be right or wrong about.

models.predicts: the element hot-spot temperature as a fraction of the permissible element temperature
models.declared_capability: V = I R asserted only where the element has not self-heated out of the description it was solved with
models.applicability_range: where the computed element temperature stays under the declared permissible temperature
possible_empirical_sources: a part datasheet's measured element-to-case thermal resistance with a measured hot-spot temperature under known dissipation
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT. No datasheet with a measured element-to-body thermal resistance and a matching measured hot-spot temperature is reachable here.

models.predicts: resistance against temperature, R(T) = R_ref (1 + alpha (T - T_ref))
models.declared_capability: a first-order linear law about a declared reference temperature
models.applicability_range: the linearization band the caller declares; the model fixes none itself
possible_empirical_sources: a standards-body resistance-temperature reference table for a defined material
a calibration certificate for an individual specimen
models.calibration_required: NO - R0 and alpha are taken from the same standard that supplies the reference table, and both are declared inputs
models.reason_if_no: PARTIAL rather than YES: the reference table is a standards-body specification for industrial platinum thermometers, derived from metrology but not itself a measurement of one specimen, and it is reached here through a third-party transcription rather than the licensed document. No measurement of an individual specimen is available.

models.predicts: the same R(T), with the material's declared limits attached
models.declared_capability: the same first-order law, plus conditions against a declared linearization band and maximum operating temperature
models.applicability_range: inside the declared band and under the declared maximum
models.currently_available_external_evidence: S-PT100 covers the law; nothing covers the ratings
possible_empirical_sources: a material datasheet stating a measured usable temperature range for a specific alloy
models.reason_if_no: The constitutive law is covered by the same reference table as the unrated record. The RATINGS are declarations about a particular material made by whoever supplies it, and no measured rating for the conductor used here is reachable. Reporting this model as covered because its law is covered would be counting the same evidence twice for a different claim.

models.predicts: concentration and temperature trajectories of a jacketed stirred tank
models.declared_capability: perfectly mixed constant volume, one irreversible first-order exothermic reaction, Arrhenius rate, constant density and heat capacity, prescribed jacket temperature and constant UA
models.applicability_range: the declared temperature bounds of the record
models.currently_available_external_evidence: none for the trajectories; CODATA fixes the molar gas constant the model is handed
possible_empirical_sources: a measured residence-time/conversion series with documented kinetics and a documented energy balance
models.calibration_required: YES - k0 and the activation energy would have to come from an independent kinetics source or from a separate split
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT. One measured saponification CSTR experiment was found and REJECTED at the provenance lock: no author, no date, no institution, no stated uncertainty, no license, and the raw data in an undocumented binary. The CODATA gas constant validates a constant the model is handed, not anything the model predicts, and is recorded as supporting evidence only.

models.predicts: the same trajectories with a temperature-independent rate constant
models.declared_capability: declared in the repository as a comparison approximation for model competition, not as a claim about a physical system
required_parameters: and the rest of the reactor declaration
possible_empirical_sources: none that would be meaningful: the model is a deliberate approximation for competing against the Arrhenius record
models.reason_if_no: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT, and the model makes no claim about a physical system for evidence to bear on. It exists to be beaten by the Arrhenius record on held-out conditions.
